title.bn: বাইনারি হিপে বড় কী আগে রাখি

examples.title: Build, insert and remove the maximum
examples.explanationHtml: Bottom-up construction makes a max heap. Inserting 12 moves it to the root; removing it repairs the replacement path.

examples.title: Extract descending values
examples.explanationHtml: Each extraction removes the greatest remaining key. This output is sorted, even though the internal heap array is not.

examples.title: Build a heap in place
examples.explanationHtml: Leaves already satisfy the heap property. Processing internal indices backward ensures each child subtree is a heap before its parent.

examples.title: A min heap for smallest-first service
examples.explanationHtml: The comparison directions are reversed throughout build, sift-up and sift-down. Inserting -3 makes it the minimum; removing it leaves the original six values in a valid min heap.

practice.title: Inspect the maximum
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..12) and values (-99..99). Print Count and values: then empty or max=M.
hints: Build first; the input array need not already be a heap.

practice.title: Verify a max-heap array
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..12) and values (-99..99). Print Count and values: then valid=1 if every parent is at least its children, otherwise valid=0.
hints: Check every nonroot index against its parent.

practice.title: Find the kth largest value
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..12), values (-99..99), then int k. Print Count and values: then kth=K after k max extractions, counting duplicates; print invalid k unless 1..n.
hints: Extract k times rather than sorting every value.

practice.title: One bottom-up repair
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..12), values (-99..99), then an index i. Assume both child subtrees of i are max heaps. Print Count and values: then heap: after sifting i down, or invalid index when i is outside 0..n-1.
hints: Choose the larger child; prefer the left child on ties.

quiz.prompt: Must a max-heap array be globally sorted?
options: No, only each parent must dominate its children
quiz.explanation: Sibling and cousin values need not be ordered against each other.

quiz.prompt: Where does a heap insertion first place its key?
options: At index n before increasing size
At the first leaf with smaller value

quiz.prompt: Which child should max-heap sift-down choose?
quiz.explanation: The replacement parent must dominate both child roots.

quiz.prompt: Which bottom-up index is processed first for n values?
options: n/2-1 when n is at least two
quiz.explanation: Indices from n/2 onward are leaves and already heaps.

quiz.prompt: Why is bottom-up heap construction O(n)?
options: Most nodes are near the leaves and move only a short distance
Every node moves log n levels
quiz.explanation: Summing nodes by their maximum downward distance gives a bounded geometric series.

quiz.prompt: What does peek on an empty heap require?
options: Return zero as a guaranteed maximum
quiz.explanation: There is no active root, even if the physical array has spare cells.

quiz.prompt: If all max-heap keys are equal, what should sift-up do?
quiz.explanation: Equality already satisfies parent dominance; duplicate values remain valid heap entries.

quiz.prompt: A new max-heap key 12 swaps upward in this array. Which root does the program print?
quiz.explanation: The key moves past 7, then 10, to become the root.

quiz.prompt: The larger child wins this sift-down decision. Which child index is selected?
quiz.explanation: Index 2 holds 9, larger than index 1 holding 7.

quiz.prompt: Removing the last active heap entry makes size zero. What size is printed?
quiz.explanation: The saved maximum remains five while the active count becomes zero.

keyPoints.en: A binary heap combines complete shape with parent ordering.
keyPoints.bn: বাইনারি হিপের গঠন কমপ্লিট, আর প্যারেন্টের সঙ্গে চাইল্ডের কী-র নিয়ম থাকে।

keyPoints.en: A max heap keeps its maximum at index zero.
keyPoints.bn: ম্যাক্স হিপে সবচেয়ে বড় কী শূন্য ইনডেক্সে থাকে।
ইনসার্টে আগে শেষে মান রাখো, তারপর দরকার হলে উপরে তোলো।

keyPoints.en: Root removal replaces the root with the last value.
keyPoints.bn: রুট মুছতে শেষ মানটা রুটে এনে তারপর নিচে নামাও।
নিচ থেকে হিপ বানাতে লিনিয়ার সময় লাগে।

examQuestions.question: Build a max heap bottom up from 1,2,3,4,5,6,7. Show the array after each internal-index repair.
examQuestions.answerHtml: At index 2 the array becomes [1,2,7,4,5,6,3]. At index 1 it becomes [1,5,7,4,2,6,3]. At index 0 it becomes [7,5,6,4,2,1,3]. Every repaired child subtree is already a heap when its parent is processed.

examQuestions.question: For max heap [10,7,8], insert 12 and then remove the maximum. Show the intermediate arrays.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Append gives [10,7,8,12]. Sift-up swaps at indices 3 and 1, then 1 and 0, giving [12,10,8,7]. Save 12, move last 7 to root and shrink to [7,10,8]. Sift-down swaps indices 0 and 1, giving [10,7,8].

examQuestions.question: Explain the O(n) bottom-up build bound and contrast repeated insertion.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Roughly half the nodes are leaves; a quarter move at most one level, an eighth at most two, and so on. The weighted geometric sum of possible downward moves is O(n). Repeated insertion can send many newly appended keys through logarithmic-height paths, so it has O(n log n) worst-case construction time.

summary.en: Build an array heap and repair it with sift-up and sift-down.
summary.bn: অ্যারে দিয়ে হিপ বানিয়ে sift-up-এ মান উপরে তোলো, আর sift-down-এ নিচে নামাও।
